description: This file defines a React component for user registration, including form fields for email and password, password strength validation, and request handling to create a new user account.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: React component class handling user registration form, validation, and submission.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state and binds methods.

methods.name: handlePasswordChanged
methods.description: Handles password input changes, evaluates password strength.

methods.name: handleConfirmPasswordChanged
methods.description: Updates state with password confirmation input.

methods.name: checkPasswordsMatch
methods.description: Checks if password and confirmation match.

methods.name: onCreateAccountClicked
methods.description: Validates form and initiates registration process.

methods.name: sendRegisterRequest
methods.description: Sends user registration data via fetch POST request.

methods.name: isEmailInvalid
methods.description: Validates email input and displays error if invalid.

methods.name: isPasswordInvalid
methods.description: Validates password input and displays error if invalid.

methods.name: renderServerError
methods.description: Renders server error message if registration fails.
